## 0.4.1

### Bug Fixes

- **trim:** Leave thinking signatures out of the request size (5adc71a)

### Documentation

- **readme:** Describe the wire format without naming openmem (283eab8)
- **readme:** Leave the chart's numbers to the chart (9bb42db)

### Other changes

- Revert "fix(trim): leave thinking signatures out of the request size" (fda3e65)

Thanks @github-actions[bot]

---

### npm

```shell
npm install -g smarter-compact@0.4.1
```

Registry: https://www.npmjs.com/package/smarter-compact/v/0.4.1

## 0.4.0

### Features

- **bench:** Report.py mech column; probe Clear arm keeps 3 results (5f3ef1c)
- **proxy:** Observation masking on by default; publish job without ServerClear (e361ef7)
- **bench:** Clear arm, ServerClear report label, publish and probe jobs (a687d3c)
- **plugin:** CONTEXT_CLEAR_KEEP_RESULTS in the OpenCode trim (ca0500a)
- **proxy:** CONTEXT_CLEAR_KEEP_RESULTS tool-result clearing before turn drops (ddd5168)
- **bench:** Seeded chain order and multi-seed chain script (1cd4e08)
- **bench:** No-recall, server-clear and low native compaction arms (40dc568)
- **bench:** Strip60k job for no-strip, prose and mask arms (878d15e)
- **proxy:** Opt-in CONTEXT_SERVER_CLEAR server-side tool-result clearing (eab981f)
- **trim:** Opt-in CONTEXT_TRIM_MIN_GAIN_TOKENS floor (3c2ae56)
- **bench:** Constraint probe for rules in trimmed user turns (2e18e39)
- **proxy:** Add opt-in observation masking (CONTEXT_MASK_OBSERVATIONS) (d0e57a4)
- **trim:** Tell the agent dropped user turns may hold rules that still apply (df3f81f)
- **plugin:** Rotate proxy.log and tool-calls.jsonl; document store purge (9a3c99c)
- **plugin:** Restart or warn when the proxy runs an older version (c48a401)
- **trim:** Default to ~50K trim with prose strip and progress note on (8ac00d6)
- **bench:** Chained SWE sessions (5f02617)
- **bench:** Terminal-Bench runner and Harbor Claude Code arms (49b6882)
- **trim:** Opt-in prose strip and progress note experiment knobs (cb74353)
- **bench:** Make recall usage answerable from the request capture (6b6211b)

### Bug Fixes

- **bench:** Keep claude.ai connectors out of Claude Code trials (75bc074)
- **proxy:** Leave deferred tools out of the trim estimate (42fb975)
- **plugin:** Start Claude hooks and MCP server with node directly; drop dead results links (b7a53d8)
- **proxy:** Serialize session-db writes across threads; read applied edits from ModelResponse (38d2c70)
- **trim:** Stop calling a remembered summary invented (bae3913)
- **bench:** Report the Mask arm separately from Native (6c425a7)
- **proxy:** Mask results that sit before Claude Code system messages (a3db949)
- **proxy:** Mask results before Claude Code system messages; record the prose-strip replay (bd9cb42)
- **proxy:** Turn prose strip off by default until it is measured (26d2040)
- **store:** Key rows by content and occurrence so an edited old message stores only itself (82149bd)
- **pack:** Ship the plugin manifests so plugins add works from npm (570448b)
- **store:** Mark prose-stripped rows out of context and count them in the pointer (e7c9f08)
- **compose:** Let settings.py pick trim defaults; align docs with them (deedf6f)
- **bench:** End Harbor job files with a newline (88db403)
- **trim:** Keep cache prefix stable and reuse side-request cuts (bbc2e3c)
- **mcp:** Page smart_compact_get so one recall cannot refill the window (9f5d7d2)
- **mcp:** Resolve a recall session_id that names no store (b5b6c41)
- **bench:** Read OpenAI-shaped tool names in the request recorder (1d5ad33)

### Documentation

- **promo:** Terminal demo opens with the prompt/store diagram (9f254a5)
- **promo:** Terminal demo ends on the savings chart (e5ae647)
- Terminal demo on README and docs home, 72% average saving chart (eb7919a)
- **promo:** Terminal demo and a single r/ClaudeAI post (0ee6be3)
- **promo:** Pitch, example, average saving (7164ceb)
- **promo:** Smoother animation, realistic trims, Reddit-first posts (bf21028)
- **promo:** Launch visuals and post copy (a2ee2bc)
- **readme:** Add the /plugin install line for Claude Code (8a76186)
- Clearing versus turn deletion, CONTEXT_CLEAR_KEEP_RESULTS (3e1b3e9)
- Correct strip60k cost estimate (a97190e)
- **bench:** Cache-after-cut probe with thinking (ce5df66)
- Note constraint probe ran on Haiku 4.5 (f64b09f)
- Label e-native as never compacted; publish e-native-153k (13af39e)
- Disclose run E deviations; add task-clustered bootstrap (2e6c418)
- Report R4000 as kv-store, not log (ac9012e)
- Cite Conte

## 0.3.2

### Bug Fixes

- **ci:** Give git-cliff the pull-requests read scope (86291b5)
- **bench:** Count only a real trim pointer (5455321)
- Name recall tools as the harness actually exposes them (3295c19)

Thanks @github-actions[bot]
